sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
C = len(c[0])
OK = set('GObYW')
def walkable(r, t):
    if r < 0 or t < 0 or r+5 > 58 or t+5 > C: return False
    return all(c[r+i][t+j] in OK for i in range(5) for j in range(5))
start = (40, 29); goal = (34, 14)
q = deque([start]); prev = {start: None}
while q:
    p = q.popleft()
    if p == goal: break
    for dr, dt, name in ((-1,0,'UP'),(1,0,'DOWN'),(0,-1,'LEFT'),(0,1,'RIGHT')):
        np = (p[0]+dr, p[1]+dt)
        if np in prev or np == (20,49): continue
        if walkable(*np):
            prev[np] = (p, name); q.append(np)
path = []; cur = goal
while prev[cur] is not None:
    p, nm = prev[cur]; path.append(nm); cur = p
path.reverse()
# simulate to verify
p = start
for nm in path:
    dr, dc = {'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}[nm]
    p = (p[0]+dr, p[1]+dc)
assert p == goal, p
full = path + ['DOWN']*6
print('verified path len', len(path), 'full', len(full))
res = action(full)
print({k: res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
